features.heading: Our Treatments
features.description: Dr Zainu's Multi Speciality Dental Clinic & Implant Centre offers a wide range of advanced dental treatments to meet all your oral health needs.

items.title: Implant Dentistry
items.description: Advanced dental implant solutions for replacing missing teeth, performed by experienced implantologists.

items.title: Root Canal Treatment
items.description: Effective endodontic treatment to save infected or damaged teeth, performed by specialist endodontists.

items.title: Orthodontic Treatment
items.description: Dental alignment and correction treatments including braces and clear aligners for both children and adults.

items.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
items.description: Aesthetic dental procedures to enhance the appearance of your smile, including veneers and whitening.

about.title: About us
about.description: Dr Zainu's Multi Speciality Dental Clinic & Implant Centre is a comprehensive dental care provider located at N.H Kolappuram. The clinic features a dedicated doctors panel led by Dr. Zainul Abid K.P and includes visiting specialists in orthodontics, endodontics, pedodontics, oral surgery, and prosthodontics.
